name: Hearth and bellows
summary: A blacksmith's hearth blown from the side by a pair of leather hand bellows.

performance.heat: welding heat for wrought iron (about 1300 °C) in a fist-sized spot at the nozzle
performance.crucible_melt: a few kg of brass, bronze or lead at a time

flaws: Can't melt iron in any quantity
The bellows need a second person (or a boy) whenever the smith is working
